entry.title: H99 Papas Fritas — Single
experienceTags: Pairings: Espresso, cola, dark rum or bourbon
Occasion: Compact premium Liga session, after a meal, evening smoke
entry.summaryHtml: Espresso, cocoa, cedar, leather, pepper and natural sweetness bring the H99 character into one of Liga Privada's most compelling compact formats. Papas Fritas uses premium Liga tobacco trimmings in a mixed/short-filler construction, retaining the dense smoke and high-grade leaf of the larger line while bringing the price down dramatically. At 4½″ × 44 and A$30.70 for a single, it offers unusually substantial Liga Privada smoking time for the money.
entry.noteHtml: The Index lists the exact 4½″ × 44 single at A$30.70 and the single variant is available.
productionLines: Handmade at La Gran Fabrica Drew Estate, Estelí
Filler: Honduran + Nicaraguan + Pennsylvania Liga trimmings
